title: Chapter 6 - Confidence Intervals
---

Quickly checking Gadfly & other viz packages with Julia.

```{julia}
#| code-line-numbers: true
#| width: 1200
using Gadfly, Cairo, Fontconfig
# using KittyTerminalImages

gd = Gadfly;
X = Float64[]; Y = Float64[]
N = 1000;
for i in 1:N
    x = rand()
    y = rand()
    if (x*x + y*y) < 1
        push!(X, x)
        push!(Y, y)
    end
end
dd = gd.plot(x = X, y = Y)
# KittyTerminalImages.pushKittyDisplay!()
draw(PNG("./random-pts.png", 15cm, 12cm), dd)
```
